modern: Take care not to feel towards the inhuman as they feel towards men.
original: Take care not to feel towards the inhuman as they feel towards men.
notification: Take care not to feel towards the inhuman as they feel towards men.
notification_original: Take care not to feel towards the inhuman as they feel towards men.

explained.summary: Don’t feel towards the people who hate humanity the way they feel towards everyone else. Even when someone behaves inhumanly, Marcus tells himself, answering their hostility with hostility would make him like them.
explained.today: When someone online is spewing contempt, the temptation is to despise them back. Refusing to catch their attitude, and staying humane towards them, is the harder and better course.
